pages.brief: A small striped bug tucked out of sight under a leaf on a washing line post.
Nell the bee searching around a washing line post, unable to spot a hidden bug.
Nell the bee stopping completely still on a peg, listening hard instead of searching.
A faint humming sound shown as soft ripples coming from under a nearby leaf.
Nell the bee rising and flying straight towards the sound of a humming leaf.
Nell the bee finding a small striped bug under a leaf at last, both face to face.
Nell the bee and a little striped bug both looking cheerful together by a washing line.
